headline: Bitcoin and Ethereum prices: 'Green July' off to a solid start — both tokens up on the week
summary: Bitcoin and Ethereum both posted gains in early July 2026 following the soft June payrolls report, which reduced near-term Fed rate-hike expectations. The report's miss boosted risk assets broadly including crypto. Both tokens had a positive week heading into the July 4 holiday.
key_facts: BTC and ETH rose on weak June jobs report
Soft payrolls reduced Fed tightening fears
Both tokens had positive week through July 4 holiday
BTC ~$63,590 before July 6 retreat

headline: Biotech M&A active in H1 2026 — oncology, rare disease, Alzheimer's attract biggest deals
summary: The 2026 biotech M&A market through mid-year shows concentration in oncology, rare disease, and Alzheimer's therapeutics. Two Ipsen deals worth at least $670 million, Roche's Phase 3 KRAS win, and continued Big Pharma interest in late-stage assets reflect sector strength. Layoffs in biotech continued to fall in Q2, extending a year-long improvement.
key_facts: Oncology, rare disease, and Alzheimer's lead biotech M&A in 2026
Two Ipsen deals worth ≥$670M
Biotech layoffs declining through Q2 2026
Late-stage assets remain most attractive to acquirers
